name: Essay ideation + review workbench
acceptanceCriteria: /essays page lists existing drafts with title, prompt preview, and a status pill
Status pills use distinct colors for ideation / drafting / review / done
A prominent 'New essay' CTA is visible on the list page
/essays/new page shows a prompt textarea and at least 5 Common App one-click prompt buttons
One-click prompt buttons render plain apostrophes (not HTML entities like ')
/essays/[id] detail page has three distinguishable panels or tabs: Ideate, Draft, Critique
Critique panel shows a streaming area where LLM output appears
antiPatterns: Raw HTML entities visible in prompt buttons (', ", etc.)
Status pill colors identical across statuses

screenshots.expect: The /essays page with drafts (or empty state) and a 'New essay' button
The /essays/new page with prompt textarea and Common App preset buttons — no HTML entity artifacts
